# `runOfExitToRunExit`

Suggests using Effect.runPromiseExit instead of passing Effect.exit to Effect.runPromise

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377123` |
| Language Service name | `runOfExitToRunExit` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/run-of-exit-to-run-exit` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const program: Effect.Effect<number, Error>

export const exit = Effect.runPromise(Effect.exit(program))
/**
                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(run-of-exit-to-run-exit): `Effect.runPromise` of `Effect.exit` re-implements `Effect.runPromiseExit`. Use the dedicated Exit runner directly.
*/
```
